{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Unassigns and deletes all linked items from inventory.
The commands operates on [[assignedItems]] array, which does not include goggles or headgear but includes binoculars, which is a weapon.<br>
Use [[removeGoggles]] and [[removeHeadgear]] for those.

|s1= [[removeAllAssignedItems]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= [[removeAllAssignedItems]] [unit, allItems, includeBinocs]
|s2since= arma3 2.14

|p21= unit: [[Object]] - soldier
|p22= allItems: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to include all slot items, [[false]] exclude goggles and headgear
|p23= includeBinocs: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to include binoculars (which is a weapon), [[false]] to exclude it

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>removeAllAssignedItems player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[assignedItems]] [[linkItem]] [[unlinkItem]] [[assignItem]] [[unassignItem]] [[addItem]] [[removeItem]] [[removeAllContainers]]
}}
